name: Henan Shijia Photons Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Henan Shijia Photons Technology Co., Ltd. operates in the optical communication industry. The company offers TO/TOSA/butterfly packages, DFB/FP laser chips, tunable low-noise single-frequency lasers, optical cables, IDM full-process technology platforms, as well as passive optical and connectivity products. Its products are used in fiber-optic communications, data centers, 4G/5G infrastructure, backbone networks, metropolitan area networks, fiber-to-the-home, and fiber-optic sensing applications. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Hebi, China.
